summary: Extensions should calibrate reviewer authority, attach external checks, and preserve each disposition as reusable project knowledge.

items.text: Weight findings by reviewer-specific precision for the task class and require corroboration or external evidence before a machine finding can block.
Convert verifiable findings into named tests, policies, or type checks so the same issue is caught automatically rather than debated in every future council.
Archive fixes, accepted residual risks, rejected findings, and escalation outcomes under stable IDs for later search and supersession.
Escalate only unresolved high-impact or low-calibration findings to a stronger model or human reviewer, with a hard end-to-end budget.
